environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway REST API. The function has an execution role with read access to the Lambda filesystem. Database connections go through pgBouncer running on an EC2 instance in the same VPC with transaction-mode pooling and prepared statement support via protocol-level named statements. API Gateway has no request validation configured. The Lambda function's /var/task directory contains the deployed code bundle including package.json, node_modules, and environment configuration files.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validators, proxy integration
config.pgbouncer: transaction mode, max_client_conn=200, default_pool_size=20, prepared statements via protocol-level PARSE/BIND
config.network: Lambda in private subnet, pgBouncer on EC2 in same VPC
